data.name: Echo
data.description:
Echo was one of the Velociraptors that were being trained by Owen Grady during Jurassic World. She was the third oldest of the four raptors.

Physical Appearance

In the film Jurassic World, Echo is brown with dark blue striping as well as having dark blue around her eyes. The most noticeable trait is the scar on the left side of her muzzle. Because of the dark blue around her eyes, she can easily be confused for her packmate Blue. The difference between the two raptors is that Blue's striping does not fully cover her eyes, her blue coloration whom she is named after is brighter, and Blue's stripe has white in it.  She has a Cloaca that is roughly 2-3 inches deep.  With gecko DNA in her genes, Echo is the smallest raptor and a bit of a black sheep. She often keeps to herself.  She is still considerably larger than an animal such as a lion like Greenstar, for example.  She has the wettest cloaca compared to her other three sisters, being as wet as a tropical rainforest during a monsoon, although she has yet to have sex.  She is likely very horny like her sisters due to the lack of male dinosaurs in the park when she lived there.  She is also likely to be more eager to be penetrated than her sisters, especially more eager than Blue would be.

History

Creation

Echo was created by InGen for the IBRIS Project where she was the third Velociraptor created for the facility.  When she was born, Owen Grady imprinted on her, which allowed him to train her. In her youth, she battled Blue for control of the park's Velociraptor pack, however Blue was the victor. Echo gained a scar across her face from the encounter and her jaw became permanently offset.  Due to her permanent sneer, some of the Jurassic World dinosaur handlers nicknamed her "Elvis".

Jurassic World Containment Breach

Just before the incident occurred, Blue, Echo, Delta, and Charlie were being trained by Owen in their paddock. After the pig used to lure them escaped its holding pen, Leon, a newly hired Jurassic World employee, tried to capture it, but Echo managed to snatch the pig in her jaws, causing Leon to fall into the paddock. Before the raptors could pounce on the handler however, they were thwarted by their trainer in time to save Leon's life.

Echo and her packmates were later used to stop the genetic hybrid Indominus rex's rampage. However, Echo and her packmates were able to communicate with the hybrid, which ordered them to attack the humans following them. She and Delta then arrive back at the compound and attack the mobile veterinarian vehicle (MVU-12) Claire Dearing and the Mitchell brothers were hiding in. After Delta kills an InGen Soldier, Echo lunges through the driver's side window and tries to kill Claire but ends up falling out. They then continue their pursuit of the vehicle on foot. Echo tried to attack the driver's side again, but is driven into a tree by Claire.

They later caught up with Owen, Claire, Gray, and Zach, and reinstated Owen as their pack alpha. When the Indominus ordered them to attack again, they instead followed Owen's orders.  Echo and Delta were barely able to escape the Indo Rex when they were beginning to get overwhelmed before Blue arrived and saved the day.
Like Blue, Echo learned an important lesson on trusting creatures that can speak the Velociraptor language.  
Five years later, when Isla Nublar was in danger of being destroyed by Mount Sibo, Echo and her sisters would meet an individual they had not seen in a long time, a feral white lion named Greenstar, who had helped train them after birth, and had been the one to have Owen chosen as the trainer.
Echo and her sisters would be rescued by Greenstar in a race against time and against InGen due to Mount Sibo’s impending eruption despite Greenstar being banned from returning to the island due to controversy surrounding his assistance in funding the Raptors and park Monorail. Echo and her sisters would be relocated much to their anger until they would learn that Greenstar did it to save them from an InGen trap. InGen is still currently after Echo and her sisters at the time of the roleplay.

In the post relocation, Echo and her sisters seem interested in gaining a new island home to live on. Currently her and her pack are hiding on Board the RMS Queen Elizabeth II, a former Cunard OceanLiner now owned by Klaus, who is Greenstar’s adopted Father.  She and her sisters were relocated due to the volcano threatening to explode, and barely got rescued before it did, destroying their original home.

Like her sisters, Blue, Charlie, and Delta, Echo was created by InGen who had received funding help from General Greenstar, for the IBRIS Project sometime before 2015 as the third raptor of the project.
